strongest_angle: Breaking down the confirmed scheduling bottleneck where six major MCU films must precede the next Tom Holland Spider-Man installment, shifting expectations for the franchise timeline.

key_facts.fact: Sony Pictures chairman and CEO Ravi Ahuja addressed the Spider-Man 5 release timeline in an interview with Variety, stating that they do not have a release date for it yet.
Marvel Studios and Sony Pictures have six major new movies expected to be released before Spider-Man 5.
Spider-Man: Brand New Day premiered on July 31, marking Tom Holland's fourth Marvel Cinematic Universe Spider-Man film.
